product: Allow ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms in context-based ingress policies
tagline: Context based ingress policies can now allow traffic from ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms.
what_it_does: Context based ingress policies can now allow traffic from ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms. Databricks keeps their published IP ranges current, so you don't track the IPs yourself. Use these rules to allow hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, such as the Databricks Genie plugins for ChatGPT and Claude, to reach your workspace.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Context based ingress policies can now allow traffic from ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms. Databricks keeps their published IP ranges current, so you don't track the IPs yourself.

capabilities.title: Create workspace-level policies, configure public
capabilities.desc: Create workspace-level policies, configure public, private, and cross-workspace rules, and attach policies to workspaces.

capabilities.title: Migrate workspace IP access lists
capabilities.desc: Migrate workspace IP access lists to context-based ingress

capabilities.title: Move existing workspace IP access
capabilities.desc: Move existing workspace IP access lists into a context-based ingress policy.
